game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: magbee
quote:
Tried it. Played it for 60h now. Cant steal neighbours car in "grand theft auto" or shoot. It's no more arcade gta it's just too realism in a game. The problem is here that you have the forced love in this game. Gta was about money, criminals and not a bad mother and a simple man. I don't want a man that progressed his own house, he is a criminal and should let made houses and not himself. Got hyped for nothing.... its also not possible to tune stolen cars, u need to buy them in "grand theft auto". The endings are also not what I really expected... you can't kill lgbtq members or women in the game. Wonder why... it was all possible back then and it's just normal stuff back then in vice city, you had some kill mission behind the buildings. 

For waiting 13 years, to get nothing new and somehow different, it's more love simulation than actually gta. for me a 0/10.
